Céilí Band 2022 Tune

This tune was the opening tune of “ The Grange Céilí Band” in the senior competition in this years Fleadh. If anyone can let me know the name of it I’d appreciate it. I have very little experience with sheet music so if there are errors in it I do apologise.

Re: Fleadh Tune

Apologies for getting the wrong Fleadh! Hence the tunes not matching!
Looks a good tune, though best to keep quaver notes in groups of 4: see bars 2 and 3, 10 and 11, and it all goes a bit awry after the first 5 lines, with bar lines in the wrong places: that run of semi quavers is your lead notes, on 4th note of the bar into the next bar. I don’t do ABC so am going on what the notation score looks like.

↳ Posted by trish santer on August 16th, 2022.

Re: Gan Ainm

Thanks trish for your comments and advice. To be honest I know absolutely nothing about the structure of music. When I hear a tune I just hear Do Re Me’s. EasyABC allows me to type in notes in that format and then I just tweak the length of the notes to make it sound as close as I can get it to the recording. There must be some little difference between EasyABC and the software used on this site as it definitely sounds better in EasyABC.

↳ Posted by Richie Mahoney on August 17th, 2022.

Re: Gan Ainm

The first version sounded fine, the second one also sounds fine (as far as I hear it), but the notes have to “make sense” - a 4/4 measure usually doesn’t have notes arranged in groups of three, three and two / five and three / six and two / or any other combination. The notes also have to add upp - the missing EF of your measure 16 appears as the beginning of measure 17, and the rest is history. One mistake is all it takes for the bar lines to start appearing in seemingly random places.

I added a second setting: your notes + my groups + my bar lines.

↳ Posted by jeff_lindqvist on August 17th, 2022.

Re: Gan Ainm

Ok so I’ve found out the name of the tune. It is a scottish march composed by Jimmy Shand called The Auchtermuchty Gala March.

↳ Posted by Richie Mahoney on November 28th, 2022.

Re: The Auchtermuchty Gala

The Auchtermuchty Gala still happens, as far as I know, but it also used to coincide with the now defunct Auchtermuchty Trad Music Festival.

You can see Sir Jimmy Shand’s statue just a few yards down the road from “The Cycle” (a pub) in the car park there. I even played one of his tunes “Dundee City Police Pipe Band” but he didn’t feel like joining in that day. :-)

↳ Posted by 🎻 Melody Player 🎻 on November 29th, 2022.
